m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: A Child of Raven - you hold her prisoner! Release her or perish!
I have failed in my charge. You have defeated me, but rest assured: Raven will avenge me, and her Child.
We're not here to hurt this Raven-Child, you idiot, we're here to save her! We need to get her to the Cave of Quickening immediately!
Your mercy proves your words. You cannot reach the Cave of Quickening this way - I have collapsed this end of the Ashen Caves to protect it.
Come, I will lead you to the Cave of Quickening by another way.
There - this hidden path will take us to the Cave of Quickening. Let us enter.
Jehoa'radzim, children of the new age. You have much to explain.
The Ashen Caves await you. You will find the Cave of Quickening on the other side. Eat the Fruit and you will be ready.
Wow, this is... pretty good! What you might call a magical fruit. Nice to finally get some lunch. Okay Wizard, lead on - we'll be right behind you.
The creatures in the Caves will try to bar your way: do not let your courage waver. May you reach your destination, Stranger.
If you would take your friend to the Cave of Quickening you must proceed through the Ashen Caves. The path will not be easy.
